note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026). Guides are written for this entry, in our own words, and cite their sources beside each trophy. 28 trophies are hidden on PlayStation until earned; this guide flags them. No online trophies exist in the list: the whole hunt is single-player.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to do for it: work the roadmap in this guide from the story, through side missions, collectibles and activities, to the 100% checklist, and this one unlocks last. Budget a long hunt — GTABase puts the platinum at around 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist behind A Long Road. Keep cheats off for the whole run: PowerPyx reports that a cheat disables trophies, and GameSpot and PC Gamer add that saving stops working once one is used.
steps: Follow the roadmap stages in order: story, side missions, collectibles, activities, then the 100% cleanup.
Use this tracker to tick each trophy off as it pops, so nothing is left unnoticed.
Leave A Long Road (100% completion) for last; the platinum follows it.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (cheats disable trophies, via PowerPyx)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is one of the first missions of Chapter 1, so this bronze pops early in any playthrough just by playing the story. There is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss: finish the mission and the trophy is yours. GTABase lists it as a story trophy that cannot be missed.
steps: Start Chapter 1 and follow the story until Gone Fishing begins.
Play the mission through to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 1 through to its final mission and this trophy pops at the chapter's end. It is a pure story trophy: no side goal, no collectible and no choice feeds into it. Note the one warning GTABase gives for Chapter 1 — do not skip Lucia's balcony meditation, because the game has no mission replay and that meditation is tied to the Positive Mental Attitude trophy.
steps: Play every mission in Chapter 1 in order.
Before leaving Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude.
Finish the chapter's last mission to pop this trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Like the other chapter trophies it is unmissable: completing the story is the only requirement, and there is no difficulty setting to worry about. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter anyway — with no mission replay, a spare save is the only way back if you want to redo a moment inside it.
steps: Make a manual save as Chapter 2 opens (the game has 15 manual save slots).
Play the chapter's missions through in order.
The trophy pops at the end of the chapter.

sources.name: Games.gg — GTA 6 Trophy List (no mission replay; 15 manual saves)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 3 to its end and this bronze pops with the chapter. It is the midpoint of the story run, so by the time it unlocks you should also have a good dent in the free-roam trophies: races, stunts and collectibles all count toward the 100% checklist later, so doing them as they appear beats leaving them all for after the story. GTABase's roadmap recommends exactly that order.
steps: Play Chapter 3's missions through in order.
Between missions, try the activities and collectibles that open up as you go.
Finish the chapter's last mission to pop this trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 and the trophy pops at its close. By this point the story is nearly done, so use the lull between its missions to clear anything you have been putting off: stranger strands, meditation spots and the card sets all carry over into the post-story free roam, and finishing them now keeps the endgame cleanup short.
steps: Play Chapter 4's missions through in order.
Use gaps between missions for stranger strands and collectibles.
Finish the chapter's last mission to pop this trophy.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the story: complete the final mission and it pops. Make a manual save before starting it, because the finale is the last point where story choices can still matter, and the game offers no mission replay to go back. Once it pops, the whole map stays open in free roam, so every trophy you have not finished yet can still be earned afterwards.
steps: Make a manual save before the final mission.
Play the final mission through to its end.
The gold pops when the credits roll; free roam continues after.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (no mission replay; free roam after the story)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a named story mission, so this trophy pops by playing the story: reach the mission, finish it, and the bronze is yours. There is no extra objective hidden in the description — the mission name is the whole requirement.
steps: Follow the story until Breakfast Run appears.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at mission end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is one of the story's big set-piece missions. Reach it in the story, play it through, and the trophy pops on completion. Heist missions in this game tend to be long and multi-stage, so keep a manual save from just before it starts in case you want a clean second attempt — trophies do not need it, but the mission itself is worth one.
steps: Make a manual save before The Cartel Heist.
Follow the story until the heist begins.
Complete the heist to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a named story mission. Play the story until it opens, finish it, and the trophy pops. Nothing else is required, and because it is a story mission it cannot be missed as long as you finish the campaign.
steps: Follow the story until Child's Play appears.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at mission end.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a named story mission, so this is another play-the-story bronze: reach it, finish it, and the trophy pops. If you are tracking your run in this guide, tick it off as soon as it pops so your story-stage progress stays accurate.
steps: Follow the story until Headliners appears.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at mission end.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a named story mission set around Vice City International Airport. Reach it in the story and finish it to pop the bronze. The airport also matters for a free-roam trophy — Catch Me If You Can asks for an unscheduled departure from VCIA — so once the story is done, remember the airport as a place to come back to.
steps: Follow the story until VCIA Takedown appears.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at mission end.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a named story mission, and finishing it pops this bronze. It is the last of the named-mission trophies, so by the time it unlocks you are deep into the campaign. Play it as part of the story; no side requirement feeds into it.
steps: Follow the story until Operation Savage Glory appears.
Complete the mission.
The trophy pops at mission end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The gold for 100% completion is the real platinum gate: Rockstar has required 100% for the platinum in every one of its games since the PS3 era, and Push Square confirms the same here. What exactly counts toward 100% has not been spelled out by Rockstar, but the visible trophies map the workload — all story missions, the stranger strands, the collectibles (WAiNK spots, card sets, meditation spots, vehicles), the activities (250 stunts, 20 races, drone races, shooting range golds, 50 challenges) and the exploration of Leonida. Treat this trophy as a checklist of checklists: finish every other category in this guide and it pops. GTABase estimates around 200 hours for the platinum, most of it here.
steps: Finish the story and all stranger strands.
Complete every collectible and activity category in this guide.
Check the in-game 100% stats page; when it reads 100%, this gold pops.

sources.name: PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (100% covers story, collectibles, activities)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (around 200 hours to platinum)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like all feed the counter, which PlayStation tracks for you. The fastest way is to fold stunts into everything else you do: take jumps while driving between missions, use ramps and hills on the way to collectibles, and save dedicated stunt sessions for the end. It is a grind, not a skill test, so steady driving beats risky showboating.
steps: Drive aggressively between objectives: jumps and airtime count as stunts.
Use ramps, hills and bridges you pass while doing other trophies.
Mop up the remainder in a dedicated session once the story is done.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity the game offers at least once — nine types in total, from racing and fishing to the shooting range, drone races, arcade games, bowling and meditation. You do not need to win or finish any of them, only to start each one once, so this is a quick tour rather than a grind. Open the activities menu in each district and work through the list; the trophy pops when the last type is tried.
steps: Open the activities list and note which types you have not tried.
Start one of each type: race, fishing, shooting range, drone race, arcade, bowling, meditation and the rest.
The trophy pops when the last untried type is started.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the count is one PlayStation tracks, so you can watch it climb in your trophy progress. This is the hardest silver in the list and the one most likely to need practice: learn each range's layout, use the steadiest weapon you own, and take your time on the timed lanes rather than rushing. Ranges can be retried as often as you like, so treat each gold as a session of its own and bank them one at a time.
steps: Visit a shooting range and learn its challenge layouts.
Gold the challenges one at a time; retry any you miss — there is no penalty.
When all 42 show gold, the silver pops.

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list (42 challenges, tracked by PlayStation)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations around Leonida. Each location is its own short course, so this is fourteen small wins rather than one big one: learn the gates on each course, cut corners only where the course allows it, and retry any location you lose — nothing locks you out. Tick locations off in this tracker as you win them so you can see which courses are left.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race markers across the map (14 locations).
Win the race at each location; retry any you lose.
The trophy pops when the last location is won.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different courses, not the same race twenty times, so you need to spread out across Leonida's race scene. Mix road races, off-road and whatever else the map offers, and use the fastest vehicle you have unlocked for each surface. Races can be retried freely, so a lost race costs nothing but a few minutes.
steps: Open the race list and pick courses you have not won yet.
Win with the best vehicle for each course's surface.
Repeat on new courses until 20 different wins are banked.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so the trick is the same as any fishing in the game: watch the line tension, reel steadily rather than mashing, and let the fish tire itself out before you pull it in. If Cal beats you, challenge him again — the trophy only needs one win.
steps: Find Cal and start a fishing challenge.
Reel steadily and manage line tension; do not over-reel.
Win the challenge once to pop the trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game, start to finish. Arcade cabinets are scattered around Vice City's bars and arcades — walk up to one, play it through, and the trophy pops when the game ends. It does not matter which cabinet you pick or how well you score, so take the easiest one you find.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet in a bar or arcade.
Start a game and play it to completion.
The trophy pops when the game ends.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — every mission he gives you, through to his last one. Side-character strands open as you meet each character in the story, and their missions appear on the map as you progress, so keep checking for Andy's marker between story missions. His final mission pops this bronze when it ends.
steps: Meet Andy through the story to open his strand.
Play each of his missions as they appear on the map.
Complete his final mission to pop the trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Like the other character strands, his missions unlock in sequence as the story advances, so if his marker is not on the map yet, push the story forward a little and check again. Complete his last mission and the trophy pops.
steps: Meet Kenton through the story to open his strand.
Play each of his missions as they appear on the map.
Complete his final mission to pop the trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. His missions appear in sequence once you have met him, so work them off whenever his marker shows up rather than saving them all for the end — the strand is short, and clearing it early keeps stage 2 of the roadmap moving.
steps: Meet Billy through the story to open his strand.
Play each of his missions as they appear on the map.
Complete his final mission to pop the trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida — the classic GTA side-content trophy, and a silver for it. Strangers show up as markers on the map once you have met them; each strand is a short chain of missions, and the trophy counts finished strands, not individual missions. There are more than eight strangers in the state, so you can skip a strand you dislike and still reach eight. Do them as they appear during the story to spread the work out.
steps: Watch for stranger markers on the map as the story advances.
Finish each stranger's full mission chain, strand by strand.
The silver pops when your eighth strand is complete.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. His chain opens once you meet him in the story; play each mission as its marker appears and the bronze pops at the end of the last one. If a mission in the chain is giving you trouble, it can be retried from the mission start without losing progress on the strand.
steps: Meet Randy through the story to open his strand.
Play each of his missions as they appear on the map.
Complete his final mission to pop the trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. Like the other named-character strands it counts toward your Strangers & Freaks progress as well, so clearing it pulls double duty: one bronze here and one strand toward that silver.
steps: Meet Tyrone through the story to open his strand.
Play each of his missions as they appear on the map.
Complete his final mission to pop the trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the one trophy GTABase flags as possibly missable: it reports a meditation with Lucia on a balcony in Chapter 1, and because the game has no mission replay, a story-tied meditation spot could be lost if you pass it by. Do Lucia's balcony meditation the moment it is offered in Chapter 1 — do not leave Chapter 1 without it. The other spots are free-roam locations you can visit any time, so sweep them after the story and tick each off here.
steps: In Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation as soon as it is offered — do not skip it.
After the story, visit every remaining meditation spot on the map.
The trophy pops when the 18th spot is meditated at.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (possibly missable: Chapter 1 meditation; no mission replay)
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (no verified missable list yet)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt down the unique animal Bret asks for. Leonida's wildlife is part of the 100% picture — reviews mention around 170 animal species to study — so take the hunt slowly: track the animal, use a scoped weapon or bow for a clean shot, and follow Bret's directions to the hunting ground rather than wandering. The trophy pops when the hunt is delivered to Bret.
steps: Meet Bret to open the hunt.
Track the unique animal to its hunting ground.
Take it down and deliver the hunt to Bret.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are hidden all over Leonida — in shops, houses, hideouts and out in the wild — and each set needs every card in it, so this is a proper scavenger hunt. Work district by district and tick sets off in this tracker as they complete; the silver pops the moment your third set is finished. Cards you pick up stay collected, so there is no penalty for grabbing them whenever you pass one.
steps: Pick up every collectible card you pass while doing other trophies.
Sweep districts one at a time for the cards you still need.
The silver pops when your third full set is complete.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK spots are spread through every district, so the practical way to do this is to WAiNK at every spot you pass while doing other trophies — the counter climbs without a dedicated grind. For the last few, sweep the map district by district; the trophy pops at the hundredth distinct location.
steps: WAiNK It at every spot you pass during normal play.
After the story, sweep districts for spots you missed.
The trophy pops at the 100th distinct location.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small side objectives — driving feats, combat feats, exploration feats and the like — and they stack up naturally while you chase the other trophies. Open the challenges menu regularly and clear the easy ones first (distance driven, vehicles discovered, animals spotted), then work the harder ones. Fifty sounds like a lot, but a full platinum run passes it without a dedicated grind.
steps: Open the challenges menu and clear the easy ones first.
Let the rest accumulate while you do other trophies.
The trophy pops at your 50th completed challenge.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. The partner is the key part: this only counts while you are out together, so do it during a mission or free-roam session where your partner is with you. Get the cops' attention, push the wanted level to four stars, then break line of sight, swap vehicles and hide until the stars clear.
steps: Go out with your partner in free roam.
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Break line of sight and escape until the wanted level clears.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without letting your wanted level drop between them. Plan the route first: pick three shops close together, hit them one after another, and keep moving — the wanted level must stay live from the first robbery to the third. If the cops lose you between shops, the chain breaks and you start over.
steps: Pick three shops close together and plan the route.
With your partner, rob the first shop and keep your wanted level.
Rob the second and third shops back-to-back without losing the heat.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles across Leonida. The counter ticks whenever you get into a vehicle type you have not found before, so variety is the whole game: try every car, bike, boat, plane and truck you pass instead of sticking to one favourite ride. Traffic, parking lots, dealerships and the water all hold new finds, and the trophy pops at the hundredth discovery.
steps: Get into every new vehicle type you pass — cars, bikes, boats, planes, trucks.
Sweep parking lots, dealerships and the docks for types you have not found.
The trophy pops at the 100th discovered vehicle.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus — the slow-motion aiming mode. Set it up on purpose: find a spot with a cluster of enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before the effect ends. A busy shootout or a gang hideout is the natural place to try it, and you can retry as often as you like.
steps: Find a fight with at least five enemies close together.
Trigger Combat Focus and aim for quick, clean takedowns.
Down all five before the focus ends to pop the trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, steal a plane and take off without filing a flight plan. Get onto the airfield, grab a plane, and get airborne; the trophy pops once you are up and away. Expect the airport to fight back, so go in fast and take off before security can stop you.
steps: Get onto the VCIA airfield.
Steal a plane and taxi to the runway.
Take off — the trophy pops on your unscheduled departure.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke, but the job is real: deal with Rhinos — the military tanks — and survive the heat they bring. This one pops from a tank encounter, so the practical route is to earn a high wanted level and face the Rhinos the army sends, or to get into a Rhino yourself and put it through its paces. Either way, expect heavy fire and bring your best weapons.
steps: Raise your wanted level high enough for the army to send Rhinos.
Face the Rhinos — or steal one and drive it.
The trophy pops from the tank encounter.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a clean, quiet job. Case the store first: learn where the cameras and guards are, go in when it is quiet, keep your weapon hidden until the last moment, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again later; detection is what fails the attempt, not the robbery itself.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and watch its guards and cameras first.
Rob it quietly without triggering an alarm or being seen.
Escape undetected to pop the trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape from each one. Bank vaults are the big robbery set-pieces of the free roam: each one needs planning — a getaway car parked close, a route out of the area, and enough firepower for the response — and each escape counts separately, so you can spread the five across your whole playthrough. The silver pops after the fifth clean escape.
steps: Plan each vault job: a getaway car and an escape route first.
Rob the vault and escape the area.
Repeat at five vaults; the silver pops after the fifth escape.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — the classic GTA move. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida, so watch for one on the road, block it or force it to stop, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the cops. A fast getaway car and a planned route away from the main roads make the escape far easier than improvising it mid-chase.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route and stop it.
Crack it open and take the cash.
Escape the wanted level to pop the trophy.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — every district, town, swamp and stretch of coast on the map. The counter ticks as you set foot in each named area, so the practical method is a slow road trip: drive or fly the map edge to edge and let the areas tick off as you pass through them. Mop up the stragglers at the end by checking which areas on the map you have not visited yet.
steps: Drive the map systematically, district by district.
Visit towns, swamps, beaches and the Keys — all 52 areas count.
Check the map for unvisited areas and sweep them last.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Gang operations are marked on the map once you learn where each gang runs its business — hit one per gang, not nine from the same crew. Expect each gang to defend its turf, so go in armed and with a getaway planned, and tick gangs off in this tracker as you clear them.
steps: Learn which gang runs each illegal operation on the map.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.
The trophy pops when the last gang's operation is robbed.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — one of the game's quiet, scenic moments, and a hidden trophy. Head to a bar or beachfront spot on Ocean Beach with a view over the water, order a cocktail, and the trophy pops. It is a breather between the loud trophies: no combat, no timer, just the view.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find a beachfront bar with a view.
Order a cocktail.
The trophy pops as you enjoy it.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive straight through the glass, just like the old days. Pick a vehicle showroom, get into a car inside it, and floor it through the front window. The trophy pops on the exit, so the only real requirement is committing to the smash.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom and get into a car inside.
Drive straight out through the showroom glass.
The trophy pops on the smash exit.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — a nod to the series' most famous pastime. Go to the alley, play a game of bowling, and follow through on your shots until the game is done. You do not need a high score: finishing the game at this specific alley is what pops the trophy.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling.
The trophy pops when the game ends.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — a hidden trophy tied to something you and your partner do together that draws a crowd. The description is deliberately cryptic, so treat it as a moment to watch for while playing with your partner: when a shared activity starts pulling attention, lean into it and see it through. It pops from the partnership moment itself, not from a grind.
steps: Play with your partner and watch for shared moments that draw a crowd.
See the moment through to its end.
The trophy pops from the partnership moment.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — this trophy tracks the choices you make, and PlayStation tracks a count toward it. GTABase warns to steer clear of the Irredeemable criminal profile because it is permanent, which suggests some choices lock you in: keep a manual save before any big decision, and think twice before taking a path the game flags as permanent. No verified missable list exists yet, so treat this as possibly missable and save before choosing.
steps: Make a manual save before any major story choice.
Avoid the Irredeemable criminal profile — GTABase reports it is permanent.
Keep making choices through the story; the trophy pops when the count is met.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (Irredeemable profile is permanent)
PlanetGTA6 — GTA 6 Trophies (no verified missable list yet)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — this one pops when something works on the second try after failing the first. The practical reading is simple: fail at something once, then succeed at the same thing right after. It is the kind of trophy that often pops by accident during a normal run, so do not chase it; if it has not popped by the endgame, retry any activity you failed earlier and succeed on the second attempt.
steps: Fail an activity or attempt once.
Retry the same thing and succeed on the second try.
The trophy pops on the successful second attempt.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? — the classic strange-encounter trophy. Somewhere in Leonida there is a weird event waiting: a UFO sighting, a cryptid, or some other oddity in the wilds. Explore the remote corners of the map, especially at night, and investigate anything that looks out of place. It pops the moment you witness the strange event.
steps: Explore Leonida's remote areas, especially at night.
Investigate anything strange you come across.
The trophy pops when you witness the event.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by — knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Drive slowly past a pedestrian, swing a melee weapon out of the window as you pass, and connect. It takes a bit of timing, so use a slow, steady pass on a quiet street rather than speeding through traffic.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a slow vehicle.
Drive slowly past a pedestrian.
Land the melee hit from the moving vehicle to knock them down.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies — bank vaults, armored trucks and shop jobs — and your contacts turn them into clean cash. The counter climbs as you launder, so this trophy grows naturally alongside the robbery trophies: rob, launder, repeat, and it pops at $250,000. Prioritise the big robbery payouts to reach the total faster.
steps: Rob banks, trucks and shops to collect Marked Bills.
Launder them through your contacts.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Every purchase counts — weapons, ammo, clothes, food, vehicle mods — so this one climbs on its own as you gear up through the game. If it has not popped by the endgame, spend the surplus on the most expensive items you still want: top-end weapons and vehicle upgrades close the gap fast.
steps: Buy weapons, ammo, clothes and vehicle mods as you play.
Spending across any shops counts toward the total.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages go on sale as you explore new districts, so buy each one as it becomes available rather than saving them all for the end — they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you need for Whip It Good. The trophy pops when the eighth garage is yours.
steps: Explore new districts to unlock garage properties for sale.
Buy each garage as it becomes available (8 in total).
The trophy pops when the last garage is purchased.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you find a vehicle worth keeping — a rare car, a tuned bike, a boat — register it in the app instead of leaving it on the street. Any ten registrations count, so use the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good and register the best of them as you go.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app when you find a vehicle worth keeping.
Register vehicles you discover across Leonida.
The trophy pops at the 10th registration.

roadmap.title: Play the story

roadmap.title: Activities, races & challenges
roadmap.summary: 250 stunts, 20 race wins, drone races at all 14 locations, gold in all 42 shooting range challenges, 50 challenges, fishing, arcade and bowling.
